subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate segment that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence.

Iraq was governed by __autocracy__ when Saddam Hussain was the President.
solution:
The correct answer is: **one man with absolute power**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"autocracy"** means a system of government by one person with absolute power; it implies a regime where a single person holds all governing power without effective constraints or checks and balances. (एकतंत्र)

 
 
• **Example: **North Korea is often cited as an example of autocracy, where the leader has complete control over the country.
 
 
 
• **"One man with absolute power" **directly refers to autocracy, where all political power and authority are concentrated in the hands of a single ruler. (एक व्यक्ति की सर्वसत्तावादी शक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **During his regime, Saddam Hussein held absolute power in Iraq, embodying the principle of autocracy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate substitute for "autocracy" in the context of the sentence is "one man with absolute power".

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***one man with absolute power***.
